head: Open Chair Finder app asks friends for you when your game needs a player
dek: Open Chair Finder is a 2.99 dollar iPhone app that fills an empty spot in a game: you pick the activity, time and place, and it asks your friends one by one in your order, or all at once. It was #43 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 18 November.
details: When someone says no, the app asks the next person on its own. Everyone sees who is playing, and the game goes on your calendar. The listing names mahjong, canasta, bridge, pickleball, tennis and golf. It came out on 16 November and is made by Melissa Wolf.
where: App Store, iPhone and iPad, 2.99 dollars
means: If you often text around to find a fourth for cards or a court game, the app does the asking for you.
todo: Search Open Chair Finder on the App Store; it needs iOS 17 or later.
